description.narrative: The objective of the Mineral Development Support Project is to strengthen the capacity of key institutions of Burkina Faso to manage the industrial mineral sector. There are three components to the project, the first component being fostering beneficial mineral resources development. The objectives of this component are to secure increased private sector investment in mining, and increase value derived by government from these investments through: (i) updating of the national mining policy, legal and regulatory frameworks, and (ii) improvement in the availability of geo-scientific information and in sector promotion. The second component is the strengthening institutional sector management, coordination, and accountability. The objective of this component is to strengthen the institutional capacity of the government and other stakeholders for efficient and transparent mineral sector management through improved sector management capacities at the ministries in charge of mines, finance, and environment. Finally, the third component is the project management. This component will support project implementation and management by a Project Management Team (PMT) located in the Department of Mines under the Ministry of Mines, Energy and Quarrying (MMQE).
To strengthen the capacity of key institutions of Burkina Faso to manage the industrial mineral sector.

title.narrative: Community members trained and consulted in the development of the Mining Community Development Framework

comment.narrative: A national framework for mining community development was drafted. The indicator reached its target.
The guides for mining inspection and environmental inspection were not drafted.

Number of people trained in the implementation of environmental legislation regarding mining operations
Average number of days to process a mineral license application

comment.narrative: The average number of days to process an exploration permit application was initially underestimated due to titles requested but that had not been processed or accounted during project preparation.

title.narrative: Number of geological sheets covered by geo data acquisition
Number of exploration sites inspections commissioned by the Geology Office
Percentage of industrial mines covered by annual tax controls

comment.narrative: According to the practice by the Ministry of Finance in Burkina, tax control of industrial mining company occur once every three years. There are no annual tax control of mining companies. The indicator was reached in the fact that each industrial mining company was controlled at least once within a three year period.

title.narrative: Percentage of industrial mining operations covered by environmental inspection

comment.narrative: The indicator target was reached because all mines since 2014 were controlled on annual basis. In 2017, 27 industrial and semi-mechanized mines were controlled out of 28. The only mine that wasn't controlled is the mine of Inata due to security issues. In 2018, all mines were controlled.

title.narrative: Percentage of industrial mining operations covered by annual technical inspection

comment.narrative: This indicator's target value was reached. Over the lifetime of the project 82.14% of mines were controlled.
